notes.title: New Boss, Laser Head
notes.content:
-a quick heads up that all the shops have a button prompt to open them now.  If you hit PING or INTERACT (F on the keyboard or Y on the controller) when you are in or near a shop then the shop will open.  They don't open on their own when you are close anymore to make them less jarring and unexpected.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/f3be74d00b7ae242429a1f7ad16307254c3274be.png[/img]

-the red forest has undergone some seasonal changes ... it was feeling a bit too big and empty so I shrunk it down some and added a bunch more to it like enemies, a cave, and a new boss.

-the new boss has a laser head that will hurt you if it gets you.  You can check out a bit of the fight [url=https://bsky.app/profile/robertnally.bsky.social/post/3lf6zk5zjvc2b]here[/url] on Bluesky.

-the stalker enemy has had a bug fixed so it should be more aggressive, a little more challenging, and a bit more fun now.

-bombs now take multiple hits to kill instead of just one.

-bats have been added.

-small, laser robots had a bug fixed where they wouldn't follow you correctly at the right height.  They also had their attack radius expanded so they'll feel more aggressive and challenging now.

-In the red forest, you'll also find a cave.  It's a very small dungeon with a specific gameplay challenge and some rewards for working through it.  You can check it out [url=https://bsky.app/profile/robertnally.bsky.social/post/3lh5ndpjar226]here[/url].

[url=https://bsky.app/profile/robertnally.bsky.social/post/3lgm3x45j622y]There is another cave that you can find later in the game as well[/url].  The smaller nature of the caves allows them to have challenges that probably wouldn't work for bigger or more open levels.  I'm hoping to add some more of these down the line. 

-fixed possible bug with lower quality settings related to anti-aliasing.

-most items and pickups do a better job of explaining what they are and what they do now.

-a bunch of levels got some polish to make them better.  Despite some of the new enemies being a little bit harder, the levels have been smoothed out to make them a little easier.  Hopefully anyway.

-lots of other miscellaneous bug fixes and art improvements.

notes.title: Added Map Shop and New Armor Accessories
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/842d861f80d46b2c64bf81dc34b2c9ddf07c0aed.jpg[/img]

-new map shop and map system.  Top down maps of certain areas or zones can be purchased now from the Map Shop.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/e5d58bafdf3bfb4ccb36ad0667889cadcab1db9e.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/85a1df20a5215034d0aa2cc88449dfb88ae90cce.jpg[/img]

Once you purchase a map, you can view it anytime from your world map or galaxy map.  Just click the magnifying glass to zoom in to an area, once you've purchased it from a shop.  

Maps cost ETA time.  You'll need to at least have the cost of the map plus 7 minutes (so you don't die right away) in order to purchase a map.  Purchased maps will also give you a clue as to where you can find keys, time, and abilities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/ca9fbac52cbecf913ca3c7140adb1bd7a1b2ef64.jpg[/img]

-new armor set.  There is a new armor set that you can find and put on in the Accessories Shop.  You can find most of the new armor hidden throughout the city level.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/4ab410a2b4933f7b8012fbf43a83cf72f0859ca6.jpg[/img]

You can also add armor set 1 to your character or mix and match between the two armor sets.  I'm hoping to add some more armor pieces down the line.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/ef9adc771181e5447ab4fcf4a159a43aa1f06f7a.jpg[/img]

Also, one of the new armor pieces is a tail.  (I've been playing a lot of Black Myth Wukong lately)

I have some new levels in the works along with a new enemy.  I'm hoping to add some more enemies and some more quests and quest improvements in the future.

-other miscellaneous bug fixes and art improvements.

notes.title: Small Patch with some Bug Fixes
notes.content:
This is just a small patch with some bug fixes.

-the bug that caused large levels like the red forest to crash when loading is fixed now.  I did a bunch of testing and found the problematic line of code.  I also tweaked some other code to prevent loading issues in the future.

-I reworked the Pause Menu so it should appear in front of most, if not all, other UI.  If you Pause when a shop is open you'll close the shop screen and open the pause menu.

-the Controls screen layout has been re-worked too, which should hopefully be easier to navigate and read.

-other smaller miscellaneous art and bug fixes

Still a ways to go in terms of clearing out most of the bugs, but this patch should help a bunch.

notes.title: Added Surfing, Update Notes for 1-18-2024
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/6392feaa5429920fa20c6c4b41ce5de016756a20.jpg[/img]
-added surfing.  Surfing is essentially gliding, but when you are on the ground so surfing requires the gliding ability.  When you are gliding on the ground, or surfing, you'll go faster, but more energy gets used.

Surfing is 2.5 energy per second
Gliding is 0.1 energy per second

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/ebfcd338c47ddf4f95ba69e7bc7ef0579b2a046b.jpg[/img]
Try pulling up when surfing to start gliding and saving energy, then return to the ground to pick up speed and get some energy back.  You can kind of move up and down like a sine wave to keep momentum and energy going.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/52c2339130b7aefc7bd259fb062058d2a8715ae1.jpg[/img]
-added edge detection option in Options.  It puts outlines on objects past a certain distance.  It's kind of like a toon shader.  I left it off by default.  Do you like it and think it should be ON by default?  Let me know in the comments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/bbc1e3b2881386e84ae680e162d97948fee9b284.jpg[/img]
-added procedural grass option in Options.  Turns the procedural grass OFF.   Helps with optimization and performance on slower devices.  At the moment you need to reload the level in order for the setting to take effect on that level.  Once the setting is changed, other levels should load according to the setting.

-miscellaneous other bug fixes and art improvements

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41780235/522ef83b01b56e030df31c0e4d94b11335e785fa.jpg[/img]
There is a Sensitivity slider for controllers and mice in the Controls Panel.  Just click the Control Mapping button on the right to edit the controls.  From there, if you click Sensitivity under Settings, you can edit the sensitivity of the controller or the mouse.  The slider min and max values have been updated to hopefully provide more control and ease of use when adjusting these settings.  At some point in the future I want to redo the Controls screen to make it a little easier to read and find things.

My hope is that the game will run smoother on a Steam Deck in the next update.  I've also been working on a new planet.  Although I don't think that will be ready by the next update.  Enemies, combat, and game juice continue to be worked on as well.

notes.title: Update Notes for 10-13-2023
notes.content:
-the jump bug has been fixed.  If you'd like to see that come back as an ability just mention it in the comments.

-the in-game HUD has been simplified and enlarged to make it easier to read especially for combat.  The frames per second counter is in the upper left hand corner now.  The Pause Menu was also tweaked a bit to make it easier to read.

-the jetpack ability has a little starting boost now.  This should make it a little easier to jetpack off of the ground now rather than having to jump and jetpack like it was before.  Since you have a starter boost, you can also maintain your height a bit better now with the jetpack by tapping it on and off as needed.  This should help you move a bit more forward with the jetpack too.

-some extra "game juice" was added to jumps, double jumps, landing, dashing, gliding, jetpacking, pinging, shooting, and sword swinging.  This should make the core of the game more fun and satisfying.

-there is a ruins mystery element in the desert city now.  Some other level design and combat elements in the level were improved.

-other small bug fixes and improvements

notes.title: Update Notes for 9-8-2023
notes.content:
-UPGRADE SHOP: I re-organized this shop so its a bit easier to read and understand.  I think there were too many options for people when starting the game and it looked a bit too busy for someone seeing it for the first time so all the upgrades and their levels go down now instead of up.  There are also tiers.  Upgrades in Tier 2 cost 2 murals and upgrades in Tier 3 cost 3 murals.  It'll be harder to get some upgrades, but it should actually make decisions in the beginning a little easier.  To compensate for upgrades costing more murals, there are now more Mural Pickups out in the world that will give you another upgrade point.

-improved readability on Armory screen.

-put in a fix where you could see through a wall if the camera was really close to a wall.  It's not perfect, but it should prevent seeing through the world much more.  This fix may cause light flickering in some levels, but I haven't seen it too often.  I also made the collision radius on the main camera a bit bigger to help with this issue.

-the Swing or Grapple hook movement has changed.  Before it would pull you upwards a lot, and quickly.  It also would pull you forward too much if you just tapped it and it wasn't great at going forward very far if you held the button down.  It has more of a parabola trajectory now.  You'll not go forward a ton now if you just tap the ability, but if you do hold it down you will go forward a lot more.  It is harder to go up now though so you'll need to either use the jetpack more or generate more downward momentum in order to yank yourself back up.  This does have the benefit though of not hitting your head on ceilings all the time when using the ability.

-there is a death animation now and you can see the player splat against things (or from an ETA time out or even just water).  The player ragdolls and I think it looks pretty neat.  I may extend the time of the death animation later so you see it longer before the DEAD screen comes up.

-added a bit of a loading screen so now scene transitions in the game should be a little smoother.

-moved some grow gun and pinging information (or tutorial stuff) into the desert city so knowing where to go and what to do should be a little easier.

-your murals count and total deaths witnessed should now display correctly on the death acceptance screen, moving forward anyway.

-continued optimization.  Added other small bug fixes and improvements.

-QUESTION: We think we've fixed the jumping bug - the one where you jump super high if you jump (don't double jump), and then jump (x2) right when you are landing.  I think some people really liked this bug though.  Should we remove it?  Should we make it an upgrade?  What do you think?

notes.title: Update Notes for 8-24-2023
notes.content:
This update has some bug fixes:

-if you hit Pause when a shop is open, you can hit Pause again to close the Pause menu and the shop menu.  This is a partial, quick fix for opening the Pause menu when a shop is open and covering the Pause menu.
-added a Get to the Oasis quest
-made spider boss slower
-added optimization for red forest, magenta forest, and waterfall city.  This should help them load better and allow for more frames per second in the level.  More tweaking needs to be done to improve culling though (assets disappearing/appearing).
-added some more labels or info on the new eternalist screen and the Puppetmaster's death screen.  The PuppetMaster gains health every time you die.
-other small bug fixes and improvements.
